claims.interpretation: The deterministic play world uses an 800-by-600 coordinate extent; no rooms, floors, or stage graph are evidenced by this fact.

claims.source_fact: A new state places the player at (100, GAME_HEIGHT / 2), the portal at (GAME_WIDTH - 80, 220), and initializes prisoners from the sentence words, an empty trail, and an empty monster array.
claims.interpretation: Initial spatial entities are player, word-bearing prisoners, and an exit portal; initial monsters are absent. This does not establish a room graph.

claims.source_fact: advanceDungeonLiberatorTime updates the player, prisoners, trail, monsters, collisions, and victory condition in that order when the phase is playing.
claims.interpretation: Movement and collision resolution occur in the same simulation advance; this is not browser-observed timing evidence.

claims.source_fact: Player input dx and dy are diagonal-normalized when both are nonzero, multiplied by player.speed and dt / 16.6, and clamped to PLAYER_RADIUS through GAME_WIDTH/HEIGHT minus PLAYER_RADIUS.
claims.interpretation: The player can move in two axes and cannot move beyond the rectangular world boundary through this update path.

claims.source_fact: A player-prisoner collision is detected when distance is less than the sum of their radii; an in-order prisoner is collected and appended to the trail, while an out-of-order prisoner flees for 1500 ms and the collected trail is rescattered and reset.
claims.interpretation: Prisoner contact implements ordered sentence collection with a wrong-order reset consequence.

claims.source_fact: Monster-trail contact rescatteres the affected trail suffix and grants player invulnerability; player-monster contact clears a nonempty trail or otherwise decrements lives and sets defeat at zero lives.
claims.interpretation: Monster contact is hazardous and has different effects depending on whether the player has a trail.

claims.source_fact: checkVictoryCondition sets phase to victory only when player-portal distance is less than the sum of their radii and trail.length equals words.length.
claims.interpretation: Portal contact is gated by collecting every word in the current sentence.

claims.source_fact: advanceToNextLevel increments level, creates a new sentence and prisoner set, appends one spawned monster, resets trail and targetIndex, and resets the player position to (100, GAME_HEIGHT / 2).
claims.interpretation: A victory handled by the component leads into a reset play state for a later level with one additional monster.

claims.source_fact: DungeonLiberatorGame obtains input and setVirtualInput from useDirectionalInput and retains camera state with x, y, and scale.
claims.interpretation: The component has a directional-input integration and a separately maintained camera transform; trusted native input was not audited.

claims.source_fact: When dimensions are positive, the component computes scale as max(dimensions.height / GAME_HEIGHT, 0.8), centers the camera on the player, and clamps camera x and y to world bounds.
claims.interpretation: The rendered view follows the player subject to rectangular-world clamping. No source-defined dead-zone value is evidenced.

claims.source_fact: The start screen control label is Move with keys Arrows / WASD, and starting calls resetGame, sets gamePhase to playing, and enters fullscreen.
claims.interpretation: Keyboard bindings are declared in the start-screen configuration; no native keyboard interaction was observed in this collection.

claims.source_fact: The play container uses h-[75vh] and w-full, changes to md:aspect-video md:h-auto, and changes to h-screen when fullscreen.
claims.interpretation: The source defines breakpoint and fullscreen layout rules, but does not prove their visual or input behavior at compact or wide viewports.

claims.source_fact: The component renders VirtualDPad with onInput={setVirtualInput}.
claims.interpretation: A virtual directional control is wired to the directional-input setter; touch execution is unobserved.

claims.source_fact: The component requests four asset paths: background.png, player-sheet.png, prisoner-sheet.png, and slime-sheet.png under /games/sentence/dungeon-liberator/.
claims.interpretation: These are concrete source-referenced render assets. Their binary contents, availability, dimensions, and runtime load outcome were not inspected.

claims.source_fact: calculateIndicators excludes collected or fleeing prisoners, converts remaining world positions with camera scale and offset, and creates an edge-positioned indicator for each position outside the viewport.
claims.interpretation: Off-screen prisoner guidance is calculated from the camera and viewport, not evidence that it was visually rendered in a browser.

claims.source_fact: The client page fetches /api/v1/games/dungeon-liberator/sentences?locale=${locale} and passes the resulting sentences to DungeonLiberatorGame after loading and warning handling.
claims.interpretation: This source identifies a current page-to-game data path; it does not establish that the route was started or was reachable in this environment.

unknowns: No browser audit was performed: runnable disposition, trusted native keyboard/pointer/touch behavior, compact/wide transitions, console, and network observations are unknown.
